failureMessage: the Actions GITHUB_TOKEN is refused on the REST variables API in every member, so the read never answers and costs a call and a log line per run
fix: read the variable from the executor's vars bag (CLAUDINITE_VARS): a task's code-work finds every repository variable already in process.env

matchLines.what: reads a repository variable over the REST API: "{match}"
matchLines.fix: take it from the vars bag — CLAUDINITE_VARS, unpacked into a task's environment by the engine

failureMessage: every label the queue reads is in the `task:` namespace, so an issue filed for the queue under a label outside it reaches no run and sits

guardToolCalls.what: an issue marked for the queue and also labelled `{invented}`, which no queue code reads
guardToolCalls.fix: keep the `task:` labels the queue reads and drop `{invented}`; the /do-later skill writes the fields a run reads

guardToolCalls.what: an issue labelled `{invented}`, a queue's name the queue never reads
guardToolCalls.fix: mark it `task:origin:ad-hoc` (the /do-later skill writes the fields a run reads), or file it without `{invented}`

failureMessage: an instruction to file queue work that leaves the label unnamed is followed by inventing one, and a label outside the `task:` namespace reaches no run

matchLines.what: an instruction to mark an issue for the queue that names no label: "{match}"
matchLines.fix: name the mark literally: `task:origin:ad-hoc`, the one a scheduler run adopts

matchLines.what: a backlog issue asked for by a tag nothing defines: "{match}"
matchLines.fix: name the label literally (`task:origin:ad-hoc` files it on the queue's ad-hoc lane), or drop the tag and ask for an ordinary issue
